name: Campingplatz Judenstein
beschreibung: The campsite Campingplatz Judenstein is situated in the municipality of Rinn in Tyrol, presenting a peaceful family camping site on a sunny hillside overlooking the Inntal valley. Nestled in the alpine landscape, it provides optimal conditions for extensive hikes and mountain biking. The park offers comfortable pitches, modern sanitary facilities, and a natural swimming pond. Thanks to its convenient proximity to Innsbruck, guests easily combine relaxing outdoor stays with urban cultural highlights.
